title: Tokenomics: Quantifying Where Tokens Are Used in Agentic Software Engineering
summary: Research paper analyzing token consumption patterns and costs in AI agents performing software engineering tasks, providing empirical data on where tokens are used across different stages of agentic development workflows.
problem_solved: Provides quantitative understanding of token usage efficiency in AI-powered software development agents.
why_valuable: Helps researchers and developers understand cost-performance tradeoffs in AI agent systems, enabling better resource allocation and optimization strategies.
